Question
========
Which of the following are pre-distributive measures? (Select all that apply.)

Answerlist
----------
* Limits on top pay relative to the median
* Employee stock ownership plans
* Living wages
* A higher inheritance tax

Solution
========
Pay limits, employee ownership, and living wages shape market incomes. An inheritance tax is redistribution.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* True
* True
* False
